newsitem.title: UK: UK inflation looks set to stay very low - Major.
newsitem.headline: UK inflation looks set to stay very low - Major.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major said all the signs were that British inflation would stay at a very low level in future but added it was impossible to say that inflation had been killed for good.
"The signs are that we're going to keep inflation very low in the future," he told BBC radio.
"You can never be certain that you've killed inflation for good....It can always come back," said Major, speaking on the last day of campaigning ahead of a May 1 election.
"The wrong wages policy, the wrong economic policy, international recessions -- all of those things can create problems."

"But as far as we can see we are in the best disinflationary situation we've known literally for generations and I think that is a legacy which bodes very well for British industry in the future," Major said.
